scope: Revisar semanticamente e provar em Xephyr os hints das duas amostras Plasma Components.ScrollBar, incluindo unidade, efeito, limite, atraso, estabilidade, geometria e interação de arraste.

findings.vertical: 15 px de largura. Arraste o indicador; a amostra não rola conteúdo real.
findings.horizontal: 15 px de altura. Arraste o indicador; a amostra não rola conteúdo real.
findings.reason: Os textos antigos diziam apenas para rolar pela amostra, sem identificar a medida, a ação observável nem o limite de que nenhuma área de conteúdo está associada.

runtime.palette: isolated default; color roles and historical fidelity not measured
runtime.isolation: Private HOME/XDG and copied local theme assets under ~/tempia; personal profile unchanged; theme not installed.

diagnostics: R1 exposed a real placement problem: the long text made the tooltip 84 px tall and it overlapped the footer. The initial horizontal observation was also recorded as missing; subsequent instrumented tests confirmed the pointer coordinates and both hover states.
R1 report was retained, but its two screenshot paths were overwritten by R2 before separate copies were made. R2 captures were preserved under suffixed filenames and their hashes match its report.

R2 passed runtime hover, drag, timing and geometry, but the probe still asserted the old wording and returned a false negative. R3 corrected only the assertion and retested the final text; both bars passed.
limits: One Qt 6.8.2 gallery layout and one Xephyr resolution; this is not a full Plasma Style color or historical-fidelity audit.
The sample has no scrolling content attached; the test verifies only that dragging changes the displayed synthetic position.
No human approval is inferred. T07 remains in progress.
conclusion: Both Plasma scrollbar hints now state their 15 px cross-axis dimension, the actual drag effect, and the absence of real content scrolling. The final native hover and drag probe passed for both orientations.
